messages.subject: Control figure position
parts:
I'm unable to control the position of a figure when converting from .Rmd to
.md to .pdf using Knitr and Pandoc. 
The problem occurs when converting from .md to .pdf. Therefore, this is a problem with Pandoc, not Knitr. However, I thought users of this may have a solution. Does anyone know how I can force a figure to remain where I've told it to be.

I've asked this question on both Stack Overflow and the Pandoc Google group without response:

http://stackoverflow.com/questions/16626462/figure-position-in-markdown-when-converting-to-pdf-with-knitr-and-pandoc

https://groups.google.com/forum/m/#!topic/pandoc-discuss/CvehHn5h08M

Anyone able to help?

Thanks
Ross

Following up on Yihui's comment, how does your document look in HTML?  I occasionally convert an HTML file to PDF just by "printing" from a browser to a file, and I haven't had any problems with the formatting.  Obviously, I haven't faced exactly your issues, so this may be completely irrelevant in your case.  But at the very least, it's a different tool to try.

-- Mike
